main_question: When was the sibling of Alice de Lusignan, Countess of Surrey crowned?
sub_question: When was King Henry III of England crowned?
ground_truth: Henry III was first crowned in 1216 at Gloucester Cathedral and had a second coronation on 17 May 1220 at Westminster Abbey.
answer_layerwise:
1220

The document states that after Henry III's first coronation in Gloucester in 1216, "he later chose to have a second coronation at Westminster in 1220." This indicates that King Henry III was crowned in 1220 at Westminster Abbey.
